{{Quote|No... control, Luke. Instruments... replonza. I'm trying to get down in... one piece.|Leia Organa|<ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref>}}
'''Replonza''' was a slang term used by [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on her way to the [[Conference with the Circarpousian underground]] to describe her [[BTL-S3 Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing]]'s instruments as inoperative.<ref name="SotME" />
